original_static_context_note: event fixtures contain 160 prefix reports; the preceding 96 reports are an explicit quiet-start assumption

motion.encoding: UTF-8 JSON in gzip; each motion retains its exact original base64 zlib block
motion.arrays: Little-endian float64, float32 or int16; eight-byte-aligned offsets

qualification.purpose: Curated recorded and designed demonstrations, not a held-out benchmark or detection study
qualification.motion_generation: Frozen approved outputs; the site build does not regenerate model samples
qualification.continuous_start: Approved source demos initialize from 160 raw common-angular displacement bins and the raw current anchor; these are not the later W5-assisted-start qualification fixtures
qualification.continuous_targets: The browser may display the recorded target path as a visual guide; this is not a claim that the runtime receives future targets
qualification.renderer_comparison: Real human reports versus renderings of the same smoothed human motion; each new comparison has 256 genuine preceding reports

source.human_path: initial + cumulative raw common-count reports; no smoothing

renderer_profile.canonical_axes: x right,y up; native canonical dy was negated once by original decoder
renderer_profile.conversion: Exact inverse of authenticated raw native/common multiplication, checked to1e-10; no smooth or generated profile data.
